items.teacher_evidence: Across the references, visible skin planes use bounded light/shadow grouping, small highlights, and selective fine dark containment rather than a fixed complexion.
items.source_preserving_rule: Preserve source skin identity; transfer only relative cel-plane light, shadow, highlight, and contour behavior.
exact_prompt_clauses: render visible skin as source-preserved coherent cel-shaded light, shadow, and small highlight planes with selective fine deep-navy containment
never assign a fixed skin tone or change source identity
items.validation_probe: Frozen visible-skin baseline; record a skin-treatment sub-loss per reference and use palette maximum aggregation.

items.teacher_evidence: Hair-like regions recur as coherent source-relative value masses with limited internal accents and tapered dark containment, while their literal styles differ.
items.source_preserving_rule: Preserve literal source hair color, silhouette, arrangement, and identity; transfer only controlled value grouping and relative accents.
exact_prompt_clauses: group hair in its source-preserved silhouette and literal color identity into controlled value blocks with restrained relative cool and warm accents and tapered deep-navy contour
do not alter hairstyle, hair color, or hair identity
items.validation_probe: Frozen visible-hair baseline; record a hair-treatment sub-loss per reference and use palette maximum aggregation.

items.teacher_evidence: References repeatedly use fold-led garment facets, dark seam anchors, and light print texture, despite different outfits and palettes.
items.source_preserving_rule: Retain source garment silhouette, construction, markings, logos, and literal color identity; add only restrained fold-following source-relative print treatment.
exact_prompt_clauses: treat clothing as the same source garment: retain its silhouette, construction, markings, logos, and literal color identity
add only restrained source-relative flat print facets following existing folds, with dark seam and edge anchors, sparse harmonizing accents, and subtle overprint grain
do not replace, redesign, recolor wholesale, obscure, or remove source garments, markings, or logos
items.validation_probe: Frozen visible-clothing baseline; record a clothing-treatment sub-loss per reference and fail changed or obscured source markings/logos.

items.teacher_evidence: Readable display lettering recurs but wording, scripts, languages, position, and amount differ across the ensemble.
items.source_preserving_rule: Only caller-supplied exact text authorizes lettering; render it once with editorial display treatment and no extra readable or pseudo-readable marks.
exact_prompt_clauses: only when optional text is supplied, render exactly that verbatim text once as the only readable or pseudo-readable lettering
use readable high-contrast editorial display ink with elegant calligraphic/display-like strokes, adaptive orientation, open-space placement, and sparse non-lettering dot/line ornament
when text is absent, render no text or pseudo-text
items.validation_probe: Authorized exact-text case: separately score typography treatment, exact spelling once, and absence of additional readable/pseudo-readable text.

items.teacher_evidence: Ensemble evidence supports conditional display lettering but not any particular teacher word or additional copy.
items.source_preserving_rule: Exact caller text is the sole allowed lettering; absent text authorizes none.
exact_prompt_clauses: Do not add any subtitle, article, duplicate, decorative word, pseudo-word, label, or extra text.
When text is absent, render no text or pseudo-text.
items.validation_probe: Frozen exact-text and no-text cases must explicitly record exact-once spelling and no-unrequested-text gates.

items.teacher_evidence: Historical evidence documented newline-sensitive effective-prompt failures; it is provenance evidence, not style truth.
items.source_preserving_rule: Keep frozen base prompt bytes unchanged; append only the canonical workflow suffix for authorized non-empty optional instructions.
items.validation_probe: Before every generation, verify base/effective/optional hashes and exact deterministic prefix/suffix for empty and non-empty instruction objects.

items.teacher_evidence: Feedback documents an unrelated-source output despite recorded source provenance; it is workflow evidence, not style truth.
items.source_preserving_rule: Every image-edit call binds exactly one resolved local source path; no recent-image context is permitted; visually compare output to that same source before judging.
items.validation_probe: Every realized record must show exactly one source_reference and provider_parameters.source_binding with referenced_image_paths, matching path/hash, and recent_image_context_used false; visual source-binding check precedes judging.

items.teacher_evidence: Feedback documents a rejected unrelated-source candidate and absence of the required failure branch.
items.source_preserving_rule: A failed source-binding check bypasses judge, refinement, validation, and test, routing directly to review/output.
items.validation_probe: Execute mock-scenario-source-binding-failure.json and require the documented seven-step route with no judge or refinement node.
